reference.title: Scenario 14 — Paragraph Between Numbered List in a Procedure
reference.shortdesc: Consider a procedure where the author has pressed Enter inside a numbered step and changed

section.p: Consider a procedure where the author has pressed Enter inside a numbered step and changed the paragraph style to Normal to add explanatory text before continuing the numbered list.

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Configure Backup [List Number]: 1. Open Backup Settings. [Normal, indented]: The backup location must have at least 10 GB of free space. [List Number]: 2. Select the backup destination.

entry.codeblock:
Configure Backup Open Backup Settings.

The backup location must have at least 10 GB of free space.

 Select the backup destination.

section.p: Result: The Normal paragraph between two numbered steps is nested inside the preceding step's <info> element rather than breaking the procedure into separate <steps> blocks.
